vehicles.name: The Rambler
vehicles.subtitle: Detective's Sedan
vehicles.desc: A sturdy sedan favored by private detectives and journalists. Reliable, with modest speed and spacious enough for a team and their gear.

features.name: Trunk Stash
features.effect: Has a hidden compartment that can conceal one Bulk 2 item from a cursory search.

vehicles.name: The Iron Hauler
vehicles.subtitle: Cargo Truck
vehicles.desc: A rugged flatbed truck built for hauling freight across rough terrain. Slow to turn, but nearly impossible to stop once it's rolling.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.effect: Ramming a stationary obstacle deals double the vehicle's collision damage.

vehicles.name: The Zephyr
vehicles.subtitle: Passenger Liner
vehicles.desc: A medium-sized airship capable of long voyages, offering a smooth ride and panoramic views from its gondola.

features.name: Cloud Cover
features.effect: While flying through clouds or fog, the Zephyr gains Advantage on Stealth checks to avoid detection.

vehicles.name: The Vanguard
vehicles.subtitle: Armored Gunship
vehicles.desc: A militarized airship bristling with plating and mounted guns, built for aerial skirmishes rather than comfort.

features.name: Gun Mounts
features.effect: Crew stationed at a gun mount can make ranged attacks as an action using the ship's weapons (2d8 damage, Long range).

vehicles.name: The River Queen
vehicles.subtitle: Paddle Steamer
vehicles.desc: A grand paddle steamer dominating river traffic, equipped for both freight and passenger service, known for its reliability and comfort.

features.name: Below Decks
features.effect: Has private cabins that grant a full night's rest even while traveling.

vehicles.name: The Iron Comet
vehicles.subtitle: Luxury Passenger Train
vehicles.desc: A fast and luxurious passenger train offering a smooth, swift journey across Shek's varied landscapes.

features.name: Rail-Bound
features.effect: Cannot leave its track, but ignores difficult terrain and cannot be forced off course by weather.

vehicles.name: The Sky Dancer
vehicles.subtitle: Stunt Biplane
vehicles.desc: A two-seater biplane known for its agility and speed, popular with stunt pilots and adventurers.

features.name: Barrel Roll
features.effect: Once per encounter, may reroll a failed Agility check made to pilot the plane.

vehicles.name: The Colossus
vehicles.subtitle: Mechanical Walker
vehicles.desc: A formidable mechanical walker designed for heavy lifting and construction, showcasing engineering prowess in the age of steam and gears.

features.name: Crushing Step
features.effect: Can move through most obstacles and structures as if they were difficult terrain, destroying them in the process.

vehicles.name: The Wraith
vehicles.subtitle: Motorcycle
vehicles.desc: A lean, growling motorcycle that slips through traffic and alleyways with ease. Popular with couriers and thrill-seekers alike.

features.name: Nimble
features.effect: Ignores the first square of difficult terrain moved through each turn.
